slots.why: Picks the places and the map view (world, a continent, or the US states pack).
slots.extrapolate_from: a continent, country or "US states" named in the request, or the Group's home region

slots.ask: Lit up on a map, or the outline alone?
slots.why: geo_map (country on a map) or country_outline (shape only); outlines are harder.
slots.extrapolate_from: "shape", "outline" or "silhouette" means the outline; "map" means the map

slots.ask: Pick from choices, type the name, or tap the map?
slots.why: quiz choices, typed_answer with the pack's aliases, or map_pin with geo_place_at.
slots.extrapolate_from: "type", "spell" or "tap on the map" in the request

slots.ask: Big, well-known places or every one?
slots.why: Sets min_area in geo.pick: tiny countries are hard to see and to name.

checklists.notes: Geography quizzes. Places, outlines and capitals always come from the geo pack (map_geometry); never ask the model to draw a map or write coordinates.
